title: Generative AI in Transportation Planning: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual review and proposal of equity metrics to evaluate whether AI-generated transportation policies and route recommendations disproportionately disadvantage underserved communities or low-income populations.
Conceptual evaluation highlighting the risk of models favoring well-documented regions and proposing balanced dataset curation across diverse geographical areas, such as urban versus rural settings.

Literature review discussing how algorithmic biases in traffic prediction models may disproportionately affect specific demographic groups, advocating for representative datasets and fairness-aware design.
